## 中文
- **桌面贴边**。悬浮窗在普通桌面可贴左、上、右。长度按屏宽比例调整，厚度可单独设置。顶部贴住菜单栏下沿，左右避开侧边 Dock。 - **独立的全屏设置**。全屏时可沿用桌面布局、淡出隐藏或另设贴边方向与长度。切回自由摆放会恢复原窗口位置。 - **QQ 音乐封面取色**。在 QQ 音乐客户端播放歌曲并成为 macOS「正在播放」来源时，频谱自动提取封面颜色，换封面时平滑过渡。
**安装与更新**。支持 macOS 14.4 及以上，包含 Apple Silicon 和 Intel 版本。1.0.2 用户可从菜单栏选择「检查更新…」。首次安装请下载 PrismPulse-macOS.zip，解压后将 App 拖入「应用程序」。
## English
- **Desktop edge snapping.** Pin the floating visualizer to the left, top, or right edge. Set the length as a percentage of display width and adjust the thickness separately. The overlay fits beneath the menu bar and leaves space for a side Dock. - **Independent full-screen behavior.** Keep the desktop layout, fade out, or choose a separate edge and length. Free placement restores the previous window position. - **QQ Music artwork colors.** When the QQ Music desktop app is the active macOS Now Playing source, PrismPulse extracts a palette from the cover and blends smoothly between covers.
**Install or update.** Requires macOS 14.4 or later and supports Apple silicon and Intel. Use Check for Updates in PrismPulse 1.0.2. For a new installation, download PrismPulse-macOS.zip, unzip it, and move the app to Applications.
